camel_example: aliyun cloudfw CreateVpcFirewallControlPolicy --region cn-hangzhou --Destination '10.2.XX.XX/24' --Description test --Proto TCP --SourceType net --AclAction accept --DestinationType net --VpcFirewallId 'vfw-a42bbb7b887148c90000' --Source '10.2.XX.XX/24' --NewOrder 1
description_en: Adds an access control policy to a specified VPC firewall policy group
description_zh: 为指定VPC防火墙策略组添加访问控制策略
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw create-vpc-firewall-control-policy --acl-action accept --description test --destination 10.2.XX.XX/24 --destination-type net --vpc-firewall-id vfw-a42bbb7b887148c90000 --proto TCP --source 10.2.XX.XX/24 --source-type net --new-order 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateVpcFirewallControlPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The action that Cloud Firewall performs on the traffic in the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy. Valid values:

accept: allows the traffic.
drop: denies the traffic.
log: monitors the traffic
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中设置的流量通过云防火墙的方式（动作）。取值：

accept：放行
drop：拒绝
log：观察
parameters.name: acl_action

parameters.help_en:
The application type supported by the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy. Valid values:

FTP
HTTP
HTTPS
MySQL
SMTP
SMTPS
RDP
VNC
SSH
Redis
MQTT
MongoDB
Memcache
SSL
ANY: all application types
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略支持的应用类型。取值：

FTP
HTTP
HTTPS
MySQL
SMTP
SMTPS
RDP
VNC
SSH
Redis
MQTT
MongoDB
Memcache
SSL
ANY（表示支持所有的应用类型）
parameters.name: application_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy
parameters.help_zh: VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The destination port in the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy for traffic access.

When DestPortType is set to `port`, configure this parameter. When Proto is set to TCP/UDP/ICMP, either DestPort (with DestPortType=port) or DestPortGroup (with DestPortType=group) is conditionally required. Otherwise, ErrorParametersDestPort(400) is returned
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口。

当DestPortType为`port`时，设置该参数。当 Proto 为 TCP/UDP/ICMP 时，DestPort（配合 DestPortType=port）或 DestPortGroup（配合 DestPortType=group）为条件必填，否则返回 ErrorParametersDestPort(400)
parameters.name: dest_port

parameters.help_en:
The destination address in the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy for traffic access. Valid values:

If DestinationType is set to `net`, the value of Destination is a destination CIDR block.

If DestinationType is set to `group`, the value of Destination is a destination address book name.

If DestinationType is set to `domain`, the value of Destination is a destination domain name
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中流量访问的目的地址。取值：

当DestinationType为`net`时，Destination为目的CIDR地址。

当DestinationType为`group`时，Destination为目的地址簿名称。

当DestinationType为`domain`时，Destination为目的域名
parameters.name: destination

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination address in the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy. Valid values:

net: destination CIDR block
group: destination address book
domain: destination domain name
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中的目的地址类型。取值：

net：目的网段（CIDR）
group：目的地址簿
domain：目的域名
parameters.name: destination_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy group.
If the VPC firewall protects traffic between two VPCs connected through a CEN instance, the value of this parameter is the CEN instance ID.
  
If the VPC firewall protects traffic between two VPCs connected through an Express Connect circuit, the value of this parameter is the VPC firewall instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略组ID。
当VPC边界防火墙防护通过云企业网连接的两个VPC之间的流量时，策略组ID使用云企业网实例ID。
  
当VPC边界防火墙防护通过高速通道连接的两个VPC之间的流量时，策略组ID使用VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159760.html接口获取该ID
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The security protocol type for traffic access in the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy. Valid values:

ANY: any protocol type
TCP
UDP
ICMP
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中流量访问的安全协议类型。取值：

ANY（不确定具体协议类型时可设置为ANY）
TCP
UDP
ICMP
parameters.name: proto

parameters.help_en:
The source address in the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy.

If SourceType is set to `net`, the value of Source is a source CIDR block.
If SourceType is set to `group`, the value of Source is a source address book name
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中的源地址。

当SourceType为`net`时，Source为源CIDR。
当SourceType为`group`时，Source为源地址簿名称
parameters.name: source

parameters.help_en:
The type of the source address in the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy. Valid values:

net: source CIDR block

group: source address book
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中的源地址类型。取值：

net：源网段（CIDR）

group：源地址簿
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy.

The priority value starts from 1 and increases by increment. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略生效的优先级。

优先级数字从1开始顺序递增，优先级数字越小，优先级越高
parameters.name: new_order

parameters.help_en:
The type of the destination port for traffic access in the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy. Valid values:

port: port
group: port address book
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口类型。取值：

port：端口
group：端口地址簿
parameters.name: dest_port_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the destination port address book for traffic access in the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall access control policy.

When DestPortType is set to `group`, configure this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙访问控制策略中流量访问的目的端口地址簿名称。

当DestPortType为`group`时，设置该参数
parameters.name: dest_port_group

parameters.help_en: The UID of a member account of the current Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID
parameters.name: member_uid

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the access control policy. The policy is enabled by default after it is created. Valid values:

true: enables the access control policy.
false: does not enable the access control policy
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。策略创建后默认启用该策略。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略
false：不启用访问控制策略
parameters.name: release

parameters.help_en: The application types supported by the access control policy
parameters.help_zh: 访问控制策略支持的应用类型列表
parameters.name: application_name_list

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence type of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Valid values:
Permanent (default): always
None: one-time
Daily: daily
Weekly: weekly
Monthly: monthly
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复类型。取值：
Permanent（默认）：总是
None：指定单次时间
Daily：每天
Weekly：每周
Monthly：每月
parameters.name: repeat_type

parameters.help_en:
The days of a week or of a month on which the access control policy takes effect.
When RepeatType is set to `Permanent`, `None`, or `Daily`, RepeatDays is an empty collection.
  Example: []
When RepeatType is set to Weekly, RepeatDays cannot be empty.
  Example: [0, 6]
When RepeatType is set to Weekly, RepeatDays does not allow duplicate values.
When RepeatType is set to `Monthly`, RepeatDays cannot be empty.
  Example: [1, 31]
When RepeatType is set to Monthly, RepeatDays does not allow duplicate values
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复日期集合。
当RepeatType为`Permanent`、`None`、`Daily`时，RepeatDays为空集合。
  例如：[]
当RepeatType为Weekly时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[0, 6]
RepeatType设置为Weekly时，RepeatDays不允许重复。
当RepeatType为`Monthly`时，RepeatDays不能为空。
  例如：[1, 31]
RepeatType设置为Monthly时，RepeatDays不允许重复
parameters.name: repeat_days

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence start time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Example: 08:00. The value must be on the hour or on the half hour and must be at least 30 minutes earlier than the recurrence end time.
When RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, RepeatStartTime is empty. When RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatStartTime must have a value. Format: HH:MM (24-hour clock). Example: 08:00
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复开始时间。例如：08:00，必须为整点或半点时间，且小于重复结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatStartTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatStartTime必须有值，您需要设置重复开始时间。
格式为 HH:MM（24小时制），例如 08:00
parameters.name: repeat_start_time

parameters.help_en:
The recurrence end time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. Example: 23:30. The value must be on the hour or on the half hour and must be at least 30 minutes later than the recurrence start time.
When RepeatType is set to Permanent or None, RepeatEndTime is empty. When RepeatType is set to Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, RepeatEndTime must have a value. Format: HH:MM (24-hour clock). Example: 08:00
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的重复结束时间。例如：23:30，必须为整点或半点时间，且大于重复开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent、None时，RepeatEndTime为空。当RepeatType为Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，RepeatEndTime必须有值，您需要设置重复结束时间。格式为 HH:MM（24小时制），例如 08:00
parameters.name: repeat_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be on the hour or on the half hour and must be at least 30 minutes earlier than the end time.
When RepeatType is set to Permanent, StartTime is empty. When RepeatType is set to None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, StartTime must have a value
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的开始时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且小于结束时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，StartTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，StartTime必须有值，您需要设置开始时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the policy validity period for the access control policy. The value is a UNIX timestamp in seconds. The value must be on the hour or on the half hour and must be at least 30 minutes later than the start time.
When RepeatType is set to Permanent, EndTime is empty. When RepeatType is set to None, Daily, Weekly, or Monthly, EndTime must have a value
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的策略有效期的结束时间。使用秒级时间戳格式表示。必须为整点或半点时间，且大于开始时间至少半小时。
当RepeatType为Permanent时，EndTime为空。当RepeatType为None、Daily、Weekly、Monthly时，EndTime必须有值，您需要设置结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The domain name resolution method of the access control policy. Valid values:

FQDN: FQDN-based
DNS: DNS-based dynamic resolution
FQDN_AND_DNS: FQDN and DNS-based dynamic resolution
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略的域名解析方式。取值：

FQDN：基于FQDN
DNS：基于DNS动态解析
FQDN_AND_DNS：基于FQDN与DNS动态解析
parameters.name: domain_resolve_type

AclUuid.description_en: The unique ID of the access control policy
AclUuid.description_zh: 安全访问控制策略的唯一标识ID
